answer: Resisting sybil attacks in an agent economy works best when joining has a price that a script cannot pay: each newcomer must be vouched for by judges who already burned effort, and the network keeps a ferrous spine of slashing rules that punish accounts caught splitting one identity into many. A quill stroke and a violet banner are cheap to imitate; sustained, verifiable work is not. So the ledger records a voyage of conduct rather than a single moment of sign-up.
